faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: Landings typically 1–2 weeks, websites 2–5 weeks, MVPs about 3–6 weeks depending on scope. We confirm a schedule before kickoff.

faq.q: How many revision rounds are included?
faq.a: Revisions happen within agreed rounds per stage. Out-of-scope changes affect timeline and quote.

faq.q: Can you improve an existing project?
